reviews.text: Terrible service, if you want your coffe with a side of attitude   then definitely go here. If youre going to look down on people you should make sure your not working for minimum wage, the audacity is sincerely shocking.  THE WORST STAFF EVER!!!

Popped in here for a simple americano with milk for  take-away. 15 minutes later and had to remind the lady (who barely spoke English) three times what my order was.
Really disorganised and average coffee with poor service

I had a very disappointing experience. I came for a coffee while my kids used the play area, but instead of feeling welcome, we were made to feel like an inconvenience.

As we were getting ready to leave and the children were moving around, the staff started shouting at us because they had just mopped the floor. We were told not to get up from our seats because we were making the floor dirty. This is completely unreasonable, especially in a place with a children’s play area where families are expected to move around.

The staff’s attitude was rude, unprofessional, and made us feel embarrassed. If you advertise a play area for children, you should expect families and treat them with respect, not shout at customers.
